title: 多阶段规则链框架实现组合式可解释认知推理
summary: 提出多阶段规则链框架，融合确定性规则发现、模式组合引擎与结构抽象层，在ARC-AGI-2任务上准确率超95%，实现可解释的认知泛化推理。
summary_en: A multi-stage rule-chaining framework integrating deterministic rule discovery, pattern composition, and structural abstraction achieves over 95% accuracy on ARC-AGI-2, enabling interpretable cognitive generalization.
